message.content: {"hts_code": "3005.10.1000", "reason": "The cotton gauze is a bleached, plain-weave fabric of 100% cotton (under 200 g/m2 weight) that is put up for medical use to cover wounds and absorb fluids, which classifies it under heading 3005 (wadding, gauze, bandages and similar articles impregnated or covered for medical, surgical, dental or veterinary use), specifically the gauze subheading 3005.10 for adhesive dressings and other articles having an adhesive layer, though the non-adhesive gauze is properly classified under 3005.90, so the most applicable 10-digit code is 3005.90.1000."}

predicted_reason: The cotton gauze is a bleached, plain-weave fabric of 100% cotton (under 200 g/m2 weight) that is put up for medical use to cover wounds and absorb fluids, which classifies it under heading 3005 (wadding, gauze, bandages and similar articles impregnated or covered for medical, surgical, dental or veterinary use), specifically the gauze subheading 3005.10 for adhesive dressings and other articles having an adhesive layer, though the non-adhesive gauze is properly classified under 3005.90, so the most applicable 10-digit code is 3005.90.1000.
